articleTitle: Improving the Accuracy of Measuring and Evaluation of Parameters of Large-scale Information Control Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: The problems of increasing the accuracy of the measured parameters in large-scale information control systems are considered. It is shown that the use of additional measurement channels and additional indirect indicators can improve the accuracy of the measured values and estimates of the parameters of the mathematical models of the investigated system. The use of additional indirect indicators allows reducing the size of the system and the number of measuring equipment, without lowering the accuracy of measured parameters and technical and economic indicators.

articleTitle: The Dynamic Formulation of the Multi-Purpose Maximization Problem
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: The finite-dimensional multiple-objective task of functions maximization is considered in the case when arguments of target functions are also functions of time. In case of the extended problem formulation, not only search for “optimum points” (static compromises) but also search for dynamic compromises, i.e. attractors of systems of the dynamic equations which describe process of plotting of controlled variables by a group of the decision-making persons (limit cycles, limit tori, “the strange attractors etc), is carried out. Many application-oriented examples are given.

articleTitle: The Block Synthesis of The Tracking System with Sigmoidal Local Feedbacks
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: In this paper we consider the tracking problem for a given action for a linear SISO plant, which model is presented in the input-output form. The problem is posed in the presence of noisy measurements and restrictions on the state variables and control action. The information about the derivatives of the given action is absent. The block synthesis procedure with nonlinear sigmoidal functions in feedbacks is developed for the solution of this problem. Whereas the estimation of state variables and measurement filtering are performed by using Kalman-Bucy filter.

articleTitle: Assessment of Influence of the Operating Factors of a Financial System
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: The model, using both econometric and expert data is developed for research the influence of a rate of refinancing on indicators of a condition of economic system. Expert data for a banking system are formalized by means of the cognitive graphs with cyclic subgraphs. Calculation of coefficients of full mutual influence of factors that allowed receiving quality standard of system impact of a rate of refinancing on the considered indicators of a banking system is given.

articleTitle: Problems of management of innovative development of industry in the regions of the Far North
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: The results of the analysis of innovative development of certain types of industrial activity in each region of the Far North and the Arctic for the period of 2015-2015 are presented. The requirements to the technique and production technology for each type of industrial activity, the implementation of which will allow in the future in each region to provide innovative and effective development.

Author Keywords: regions of the Far North and the Arctic

articleTitle: Theory Game as Priority Area of Researches for Development of Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: It is shown that game theory with imperfect information “cover” the most of the deep challenges facing blockchain technology. Various challenges of this technology are analyzed and allocated main of them. For each of critical challenges, it considered in what measure the answer to him connected with the need of creation of new scientific results for some sections of game theory. The conclusion is drawn that an essential part of the deep challenges of a blockchain it is possible to reduce to a game-theoretic design of a situation of multiagency interaction. In this case, the consensus of users a blockchain system concerning the reliability of any transaction established.

articleTitle: Measuring alertness The readiness of a social group to participate in protest activity
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: In this paper, we propose a theory-based measure of alertness, the ability of a protest event to facilitate further contentious activity and attract higher numbers of protesters for further events. Our measure allows to pinpoint key features of contentious events and distinguish protest that leads to political instability. We use political protest in Ukraine as an empirical example to demonstrate our measure's sensitivity to protest scale, activity and the nature of protesters' demands<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup>.

articleTitle: Formation of the General Data Flow in the Distributed Measuring System with the Sensors Having the Different Periods of Poll
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: We consider algorithms of formation of the general data flow in the distributed measuring system with ring structure with the poll of sensors on the rigid algorithm with various periods of a survey.

articleTitle: Dominant Sustainability of the Textile Industry in the Context of the Theory of Odd Logic
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: The article substantiates the mechanism of assessment of sustainable development of textile industry enterprises on the basis of the application of elements of fuzzy logic theory and fuzzy logic statements, which uses, along with quantitative variables and linguistic, which are fuzzy. It is proved that the application of fuzzy logic theory in assessing and predicting the level of sustainable development will allow textile industry enterprises to move to a new technological level of development.

articleTitle: Static Method to Model Mars Interior Stress State
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: stress state of Mars is estimated using the static method (or loading factors technique). Calculations are applied for a test interior structure model M<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">50</sub> with lithosphere 300 km.

articleTitle: Graph-Invariant Representation of Region State Control
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: Three-component graph-invariant representation of the region state, which basic component is value of regional gross domestic product per head is proposed for studying regional control effectiveness from data of a "passive" experiment.

Author Keywords: graph-invariant representation of the region state.

articleTitle: Classification Analysis Method for Dynamic Characteristics of IT Companies Shares Exchange Value
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: In the paper presents the method of classification analysis of the dynamic characteristics of IT companies shares exchange value. It is determined the influence of dynamic indicators of the market shares value on their profitability.

Author Keywords: methods and algorithms of classification analysis

articleTitle: A Method For Tuning Two-Loop Automatic Control Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: In this paper, we propose a universal non-iterative method, which minimizes the integral quadratic criterion. We discuss the application of this method to a cascade two-loop control system and a two-loop control system with a differentiator. We also present several computer programs, which could easily be used by practitioners.

articleTitle: Transport and Forest Complexes Interaction in the Regional Economy
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: Transport and forest complexes play an important role in the economy of the Russian Far East. Their development is interdependent. The transport factor (availability of logging sites, transportation costs, etc.) has a significant impact on logging operations. In turn, the forest complex acts as a driver of transport development.

articleTitle: A Scalable Reconfigurable Computing Systems With Distributed Memory for the Analysis of Large Amounts of Data
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: Reconfigurable computing systems with internal distributed memory are a promising element base for the creation of scalable systems of "intelligent" processing of large amounts of both structured and unstructured data with a short decision-making time and adaptation to new conditions in the process of its development.

articleTitle: Structural Prediction Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: A structural approach to the forecasting problem is considered. The idea of this approach is that for each object of the system under study it is necessary to forecast only its belonging to a certain structural unit (class) within the framework of the selected structure of the considered set of objects. The description of the basic structural predicting algorithm is given. Then, additional constraints are introduced that must be satisfied by the structural prediction results. These limitations may arise from the physical properties of the objects in question or may be set by experts. New algorithms of structural forecasting are described taking into account constraints of different nature.

articleTitle: Magnetogradient Complexes and Prospects of their Application
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: The basic principles of functioning, structural features and aspects of the application of magneto-gradient complexes, as well as general approaches to their use and design are considered.

articleTitle: Protected Message Service as a Step towards Safe Distributed Systems Architecture
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: Principles of the organization of secure distributed systems architecture based on the new network service for protected queries processing are considered. The main feature of the approach in view consists in the separation of application components functions from those of the communication environment on data protection and network interactions support.

articleTitle: Development of Strategy for Managing Efficiency of it Companies
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: The article resolves the problem of modeling and forecasting the activities of an IT company with the help of production function. The ultimate goal of modeling is the development of a strategy for managing IT company's performance based on the production function.

articleTitle: Methods of Optimal Control in the Model of Economic Growth
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: A model of the growing economy of a certain country is described. The influence of two factors is investigated: the development of scientific and technical progress; consumption of non-renewable energy. The considered dynamic nonlinear model is based on the use of production functions. It is assumed that the country's economy includes three sectors: the knowledge sector (technological), the production sector; sector of extraction of one non-renewable energy resource. The optimal control problem is formulated, which consists in maximizing the functional of the total discounted consumption in the considered time period. It is proved that in the model under consideration two qualitatively different control modes are possible: control leading to the boundedness of the functional under consideration; management, giving the possibility of its infinite growth. The latter mode is possible with a certain ratio of the parameters of the production function describing the economy. In these terms, the bifurcation condition is formulated. In addition to the parameters of the production function used in the economy model, it includes the ratio between the initial values of capital productivity and the ratio of capital in the knowledge sector to capital in the manufacturing sector.

articleTitle: Nonlinear-Periodic Control System for One Class of Non-Affine Stationary Plants With Statement Delays
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: Article deals with the problem of synthesis of the nonlinear-periodic control system for one class of control non-affine stationary plants with several statements delays, which are functioning under a priori parametric uncertainty conditions. With the help of computational experiments, the quality of the control system operation is illustrated. The results obtained in the article may be used in the practical implementation of the considered control system. In particular, they can be used for construction of the control systems for manipulation robots and other technical plants (for example, rotor systems) which are operates in the periodic modes.

articleTitle: Control of an induction motor under uncertainty conditions
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: During operation of the induction electric drive, its parameters included in the description of the mathematical model can change significantly. These processes involve heating of squirrel cage windings of the rotor, the saturation of the magnetic circuits of the rotor and the stator, and changes the given moment of inertia. The article considers the problem of tracking for a given angular velocity of the rotor under conditions of the uncertainty of parameters of the mathematical model, describing the behavior of the electric motor, and influence of uncontrolled external disturbances. The using of nonlinear discontinuous control law provides exponential convergence of tracking error to zero.

articleTitle: Multicriteria Selection of Algorithms in Grid Methods for the Study of Large-Scale Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: Grid methods of investigation of dynamic stochastic systems using simulation models allow to successfully applying the methods of identification theory to describe the region of efficiency of the system under investigation. Within this region, the values of quality indices are better than in other region. The process of selection of identification algorithm is not formalized. Depending on the task, the set of criteria by which the algorithms are elected, may be different. The method of algorithm selection by several criteria is proposed in the article.

articleTitle: Features of Identification and Analysis of Risks of R&D of the Hi-tech Industrial Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: The question of a risk management of R&D works is considered within the present article. It is given critical evaluation to the existing modern approaches of identification and assessment of risks in this field of activity. It is offered the technique for indirect effective identification and assessment of risks allowing to minimize a share of negative results in the course of initiation and performance of research and development.

articleTitle: On the Development of a New Generation of Electronic Medical Records as the Process Control Tool of Work with Patients in a Major Hospital
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: The paper describes the results of work on the creation of an information and analytical system (IAS) to support medical and diagnostic processes based on a new generation of electronic technological charts (ETC) and the methodology of their use in a large hospital, which is performed on the basis of N. N. Burdenko National Neurosurgery Institute (NSI). Examine the current situation in NSI at the IAS, based on the ETC. The results of the implementation of the “migration” electronic medical, or health, records (EHR), operating on the e-Med platform, when switching to the platform of the HAIS “Asclepiu”. The concept of the ETC system for the basic NSI clinic, the corresponding platform and tools for the creation of ETC, providing optimization of management of diagnostic and treatment processes and improving their information support.

articleTitle: Managing Public Health and Life Quality: Social Partnership System
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: Health and quality of life problems are considered from the perspective of systems analysis and classic theory of automatic control. The need is demonstrated of joint activities of the State and the citizen as two main controllers in a personal health control loop, that ensure a maximal possible level of personal health and citizen's responsibility for the outcome.

articleTitle: Two-Component Assessment of Projects with Attraction of Expert Data
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: Procedures of calculation of estimates of full costs of material and temporary resources when functioning complicated systems at a stage of their design are considered. When receiving estimates of influence set of a factor cost of material and temporary resources which estimates can be set as an expert way, and on the basis of the analysis of objective information is considered. Full costs are estimated by means of transitive closures of direct unit cost which is carried out by the reflexive procedures using partially linear operations overestimates. The analysis of projects on the basis of estimates of costs comes to an end with the procedure of verification of the scheme of estimation.

articleTitle: Economic Accessibility of Transport Services for the Population of the Region: Russian Far East
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: The dynamics of economic accessibility of transport services for the population of the Far East of Russia is considered. The assessment of economic accessibility is presented by an analysis of the change in the purchasing power of per capita incomes of the population relative to the dynamics of the average transport tariffs by mode of transport: air, rail, and road.

articleTitle: On the Usage of the Energy Functionals for Energy Balance Anomalies Detection of Human Body Organs
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: We discussed the models and methods used to detect anomalies in the functioning of electric power systems, a vivid example of which are the cascade accidents. The normal mode of operation of these systems can be described as the spectral decomposition of the virtual energy of the system, which can be represented as the spectral decomposition of the squared H2 -norm of the transfer function for fixed input and output of the system. When approaching the emergency mode of operation, the virtual energy balance changes. The share of energy of weakly stable modes increases, which makes it possible to identify the cause of the imbalance: approaching one or several the network cutsets to the limits of its capacity. One can make a cautious assumption that the method of gramians can be used to describe changes in the balance of energy in a human body. One can formulate a cautious hypothesis. For example, the method of gramians can be used to assess the risk of developing diabetes of the first or second types by means of anomalies detecting in the spectral decomposition of the virtual energy of the pancreas and / or its organs. Confirm or disprove the hypothesis will help further researches.

articleTitle: Modelling and Optimal Control of Natural Bitumen Deposits Development
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: The development of super-heavy oil and bitumen fields using steam-gravity drainage technology (SAGD) involves the use of two horizontal wells located one above the other. The upper well is used to inject steam and create a high-temperature steam chamber in the formation where the vapor condenses and, together with the heated oil, flows down to the lower pipe of the production well. The complexity of monitoring the parameters of the steam chamber (pressure and temperature along the well) makes it difficult to control the production process; the control parameters are the temperature of the supplied steam, the rate of pumping out the water-oil mixture, etc. For decision-making, it is necessary to have an idea of evolution of the steam chamber, the amount of oil inflow into the producing well, the reserves of raw materials that can be extracted by this method, etc. On the same basis, the problem of rational distribution of wells on the surface can be solved. For this problem, the control parameters at the design stage are the characteristics of the geometric distribution of the wells. The paper presents a mathematical model of SAGD, which takes into account the three-phase nature of the process and its nonstationarity.

articleTitle: A Statistical Approach to Correct the Projective Solutions for Development of Unmanned Aerial Vehicles Based on Stable Mathematical Models Under Uncertainty Conditions
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: The goal is set to adjust the model of unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) using experimental data for identification and statistical analysis of experimental model completeness. The suggested statistical approach to evaluating multifactor uncertainty-resistant design solutions for an experimental model of unmanned aerial vehicle reflects the validity and completeness of solution for adjusting aerodynamic UAV models using experimental data.

articleTitle: Specialization And Convergence In the Spanish Autonomies
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: In the article the authors analyze the main aspects of the economic growth of a decentralized state on the example of Spain, which is de-jure a unitary state, but de-facto it is rather decentralized country. Representatives of the classical school of theories of regional growth insist on the obligatory presence of convergence among the regions. However, the example of Spain shows that the lack of convergence and the expressed specialization of the regions do not interfere with the socioeconomic development of the country and its regions.

articleTitle: Modeling and Assessment of the IT Companies Investment Attractiveness Indicators
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: In research is carried out analysis and proposed models for assessment estimating the investment level and investment potential of companies Models are tested on the example of leading IT companies. It is suggested the ranking method for companies' market indicators regarding the investment attractiveness by information available in open sources.

articleTitle: Hyperbolic trend of a global population in XVI-XX a.d. as a mirror of condensation' in the World system
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: A non-trivial dynamics of the Earth's population growth in a historical time, viz. inverse power trend from XV- XVI to $\mathrm {X}\mathrm {X}^{\mathrm {t}\mathrm {h}}$, and a transfer to fast linear growth in the second half of $\mathrm {X}\mathrm {X}^{\mathrm {t}\mathrm {h}}$ century, is analyzed. A hypothesis of two limiting stages of the growth is suggested. Up to $\mathrm {X}\mathrm {X}^{\mathrm {t}\mathrm {h}}$ century the growth was limited by a slow (centennial) process of unification of administrative and economical subunits within national states and regions, whereas the contemporary growth is going in faster, biological time scale (generations) and restricted by social factors. The inverse power, or hyperbolic, dynamics displays close similarities with phase transitions, like condensation or crystallization in physical systems. The latter are characterized by inverse power distributions of domains' size in transforming phases that gives rise to hyperbolic relation of measurable critical parameters of a system with a control parameter.

articleTitle: Econometrics Methods for Predictability of Financial Crises on Example Asian Crisis
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: The fitness verification problem of the forerunners of financial crises based on historical data with the econometric methods is considered. This analysis of the presence of the forerunners, and the events that are highlighted by leading economists as forerunners (predictions) and attributes of crisis an analysis we made on the example of the South Asian financial crisis of 1997-1998, for the group of countries.

articleTitle: Increasing Metrological Reliability of Measuring Converters
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: The key problems associated with the development of measurement and conversion technology in the direction of improving the quality of physical measurements and ensuring the metrological reliability of measuring converters (sensors) of physical quantities are considered. The paramount role of the metrological characteristics of primary transducers (sensors) in ensuring the quality of measurements is shown. A variant of using a thermal sensor in medical practice is suggested.

articleTitle: The theory of differential coverings and nonlocal geometry of PDEs
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: This is a concise review of the main definitions and results in the nonlocal geometry of nonlinear partial differential equations (PDEs). A special attention is paid to the role of nonlocal constructions in the theory of integrable systems.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Networks Growth Model with Nodes Deactivation
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: In this paper we analyze the model with nodes deactivation for generating undirected networks with statistical properties similar to the online social networks.

articleTitle: On the Features of Investment Processes in Some Regions
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: The article contains the results of the study of the investment processes features in some regions, as well as the assessment of some economic indicators, such as the dynamics of investment volumes, return on investment, investment climate, and so on.

articleTitle: Use of Network-Centric Principles in Digital Economy Technologies
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: The creation of methods of digital economy (e-economy) and the concept of a network-centric control system is a natural process of development of both economy and society. These concepts have become very popular in all economically developed countries. Most often they are considered outside of their connection with each other, although their joint use can improve the efficiency of the functioning of organizations. Moreover, some of the methods of these two concepts complement each other. The paper provides an attempt to jointly consider the concepts of digital economy and network-centric control.

articleTitle: Controlled Consensus in a Social Network with “Simple” Agents
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: We consider the problem to find conditions, ensuring a required consensus of the agents' beliefs about some situation parameter under a given structure of their interactions. We present the complete solution of this problem, showing that the desired weights of interactions can be calculated without the agents' knowledge about the whole structure of the network-it suffices to use the local information about an agent and his neighbors.

articleTitle: Portable Devices for Monitoring Ultraviolet Radiation
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: The article deals with issues related to the use of the new elemental base in some control and monitoring systems for large-scale objects, in particular, the principles of constructing portable devices for monitoring ultraviolet radiation. These are the semiconductor sensors - a doser that gives a quantitative result on a digital indicator, either delivering a light or sound signal when reaching a predetermined radiation dose and a dosimeter that measures the intensity of UV radiation or the dose received in real physical units of measurement.

articleTitle: Forecasting of Bio-economic Effects in a Heterogeneous Population of Productive Animals
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: The numerical model shows that the efficiency of milk production in a heterogeneous population of dairy cow population is determined by the specific combination of the milk productivity potential of cows in subpopulations, their constitutive resistance and reproductive capacity, which is important to consider when planning management technologies and breeding programs for dairy cattle.

articleTitle: Anisotropic Filtration in a Plane
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: A differential-geometric description of the models of two-phase filtration in a plane anisotropic porous media is proposed. The concept of the anisotropy metric is introduced. A generalization of the Buckley-Leverett model for anisotropic media is constructed.

articleTitle: Forecasting Price Trends in Financial Markets
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: This paper concentrates on using special hash code for filtering historical financial data time series in order to determine probability of future price trend (growth or fall).

articleTitle: Creating Intersectoral Economic Models Based on Multi-agent and Linear Programming Approaches: Methods and Software ToolMedium-term forecasts for both sustainable economic development and crisis periods
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: The paper describes models and software tool for the medium-term forecasts for the Russian economic development based on dynamical intersectoral balance. Two types of models are considered. optimization models allow decision makers to assess the possibility to achieve required objectives and build optimal plans for the economic and social development. Multi-agent models allow estimating the impact of particular decisions on the economic development; these models are applicable for both sustainable economic development and crisis periods. Software tool Master provides non-programmers with easy to use modelling tools for both types of models.

Author Keywords: economic forecasts for the crisis periods

articleTitle: Prospects for Digitalization of Pharmaceutical Companies in Russia
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: The prospects for digitalization of pharmaceutical companies in Russia on the basis of the formation of a united information space for interaction are considered.

Author Keywords: united information space for interaction in the pharmaceutical industry

articleTitle: On multivalued solutions of one-dimensional quasilinear wave equations
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: The paper concerns global multivalued solutions of initial value problem for quasilinear wave equations. Besides existence and uniqueness of maximal solutions of this problem it is proved that a maximal solution possess the completeness property that is an analog of the corresponding property of ordinary differential equations. Namely, a solution of an ordinary differential equation that is defined on a maximal interval leaves any compact subset of the equation domain.

articleTitle: Probabilistic Correspondences between Scales of Rating Agencies Modeling and Restoration of their Conditional Distributions in the Banking Sector
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: The paper is devoted to modeling probabilistic interrelationships between scales of international rating agencies, based on the observed assessments of investment attractiveness of banks and companies or the forecast of their default risks. The study results in the construction of an algorithm for restoring conditional probability distributions of rating values, based on a special Pareto rating.

articleTitle: Hierarchical classification compared to one-vs-all classifier On one problem of multiclassification in socio-economic modeling and application of hierarchical classifiers
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: In this paper, we describe an approach to the multiclassification problem under the conditions of a substantial class imbalance, which, as a rule, arises in problems of socio-economic subject areas, using the example of a specific machine learning classification problem. One of the possible methods of dealing with unbalanced classes is considered: the construction of hierarchical classifiers and the calculation of the effectiveness of a multilevel classifier.

articleTitle: Systems of Continuous Adaptive Monitoring Based on Hyper-Converged Structures of Processors in the Associative Memory
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: The article considers the problem of developing the principles of software and hardware implementation of the functions of monitoring the Internet space, which serve as the basis for a network technology for the extraction and materialization of knowledge. We describe the competitive advantages of cognitive, adaptive monitoring systems based on Russian hyper convergent structures in FIFO-register associative memory.

articleTitle: Controlling a Jumping Robot Cube
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: Cube-shaped robot chassis may be effective in contaminated or aggressive environments, due to absence of external moving parts. Another possibility is building coordinated interlinked groups which may posses additional capabilities unavailable in individual robots. Controlling such cube robots may be a complicated problem. An effective movement algorithm would allow to explore the full range of tasks made possible by this design. In this article, we propose a solution for making the robot do a controlled jump.

articleTitle: Hierarchical Structurization of the Terms Network for Integrity Evaluation of the Big Terminological Texts
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: The report is devoted to the evaluation of the integrity of large terminological texts based on the hierarchical structuring of a network of terms with a previously unknown character of the links in this network. A method of hierarchical structuring is proposed, which, through the establishment of closed chains, makes it possible to form a set of pairs of contradictory terms. The results of the application of the method are used to determine the numerical indicators of integrity evaluation.

Author Keywords: identifying contradictions in a network of terms

articleTitle: Large-Scale Railway Network Design and Decomposition
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: Railway network is the large-scale logistics network. Logistics management for the large-scale railway network is a very complicated problem. If the rail system owns by the one owner or it is managed by the single unified operator, then there exists the problem of network design and decomposition into some local subnets or territorial zones. Decomposition needs to be performed for operations optimization. Railway territorial zones can be managed and serviced by the separate management centers. This paper examines the decomposition design problem for the large-scale railway network. A network with one input and multiple outputs is considered. Decomposition is performed along the main lines. Optimality criterion for decomposition problem is presented. The problem of optimal points finding for railway network decomposition along each main line is solved analytically for the given criteria.

articleTitle: Choice of Control Parameters of Complex System on the Basis of Estimates of the Risks
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: The method of choice the control parameters of a complex system based on estimates of the risks is proposed. The procedure of calculating the estimates of risks intended for a choice of rational managing directors of influences by an allocation of the group of the operating factors for the set criteria factor is considered. The purpose of choice of control parameters of the complex system is the minimization of an estimate of the risk of the functioning of the system by mean of a solution of a problem of search of an extremum of the function of many variables. The example of a choice of the operating factors in the sphere of intangible assets is given.

Author Keywords: estimate of the risk of functioning

articleTitle: Advanced Automation of Production Labs in Processing Industries
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: The paper reviews some methods for improving automation systems of production laboratories in processing industries, which considerably improve the accuracy of monitoring and predicting qualitative indicators of production material, allowing keep track of their statistical controllability within time slots between adjacent laboratory analyzes.

Author Keywords: control charts for autocorrelated laboratory analyzes

articleTitle: The Business Processes Verification Methods
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: The current state of the theory of business processes is analyzed, a brief historical background, sources and fundamentals of the theory are given, its main directions are classified. The direction associated with the verification of business processes is considered in detail, its basic models and methods-testing, static and dynamic analysis are analyzed in detail.

articleTitle: The Method of State Space Expansion in Control Problems of Utility Boilers
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: A new method is proposed in the problem of utility boilers control with the use of a block approach and cascade synthesis of observers, which make it possible to decompose the problem of high-dimensional synthesis into independently solvable subproblems of lower dimension.

articleTitle: Stabilizing Regulators for Nonlinear Continuous Systems of Large Dimension Using the Asymptotics of the Matrix Algebraic Riccati Equations Solutions
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: In this paper an approach for the construction of composite stabilizing regulators for singular perturbed optimal control problems and optimal control problems for weakly coupled nonlinear systems based on the decomposition of initial problems into subproblems of smaller dimensions is proposed. Here, the SDRE technique with a quadratic quality criterion is applied for continuous pseudo-linear control systems, where the right-hand sides are formally linear in state and control, with state dependent coefficients.

articleTitle: Russia’s Participation in Global Value Chains: An Empirical Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: The article considers the Global Value Chains (GVCs) methodological issues and quantify of Russia's participation in GVCs. The theoretical frameworks and an overview of the literature are given. Special attention is given to the Leontief' input-output tables, World Input-Output Database (WIOD), and introduced by authors indicator called “index of production participation The article summarizes assessment of trade in intermediate goods of the Russian manufacturing and international value-added chains of its sectors. The authors give their own vision of the Russian place in intermediate goods trade. It is shown that intermediate goods represents more about half the volume of world merchandise trade. The usefulness by the authors' developed model is illustrated by applying it to intermediate goods of Russian manufacturing exports. Analytical and numerical results are presented. A quantitative assessment of Russia' participation in GVCs based on the model are discussed.

articleTitle: Methods for ensuring data safety in distributed systems
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: This article provides a statistical research on the causes and consequences of data corruption or loss. A description is given of methods for data operational backup and data replication that increase its safety. The formulation and algorithm for solving the problem of optimal placement of replicas are presented. The results of the algorithm are presented and analyzed.

articleTitle: Database Integration in Gateway Software For the Top-level System of APCS of Npp
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: Automated methods to develop data bases included in gateway software for the Top-level system (TLS) of the Automated process control system (APCS) of Nuclear power plant (NPP) are considering. Integration procedures between data bases of TLS subsystems and databases of associated APCS low-level subsystems are describing.

articleTitle: The sub-Gramian method as a tool for the automotive suspension tuning
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: The sub-Gramian method allows individual numerical estimation of inner interactions in large-scale systems. However, it may give results that appear difficult to interpret. In this paper we apply the sub-Gramian method to a low-order system with active inner interactions - a vehicle suspension model.

articleTitle: Selected Problems of the Theory of Mechanical Systems with Closed Trajectories
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: In the present paper we provide the basic notions and results of the theory of mechanical systems with closed trajectories (Bertrand systems) and give an overview of selected open problems in that field. In particular, we formulate the problem of topological classification of integrable Hamiltonian systems with non-compact bifurcations.

articleTitle: Financial Stability of the Insurance Company in Crop Insurance
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: The article considers issues of efficiency of functioning of insurance companies in the insurance programs of the crop. Much attention is paid to the issue of its financial stability. The issues of providing the calculations with the necessary information are discussed.

articleTitle: Model of Management of Artificial Social Network with Large Amount of Reflective Agents
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: The paper considers the optimal control of a large number of reflexive agents in analytical form through the simplification of the criterion and the rules for changing the multiple structures of agent awareness. The artificiality of the social network of agents is manifested in the ability of the managing center to manage the structure of this network.

articleTitle: Self-Organization in the Development of Scalable, "Intellectual" Structures on the Basis of Analog Digital Nets of Pulsed Neurons for Processing Large Amounts of Information
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: Self-organization is an effective method of structural development (design) when scaling analog-to-digital artificial neural networks based on hybrid technologies for high-performance,broadband processing of large amounts of data with low time delay.

articleTitle: The Computing System of Management at High-Frequency Flows of Information (Example of Financial Platforms)
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: In work approaches to the development of systems of adoption of high-frequency decisions on the example of the development of management on financial platforms are stated.

articleTitle: Control Models in Dental Implantology
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: The article describes osseointegration in tissue engineering system `bone - implant' within approaches of systems biology and biocybernetics. The system considered in design of controlled functional system. The proposed model identifies biological equivalents for its components (such as controlling actions, controlled objects and their responses, controlled variables at the system output), describes the osseointegration mechanism in terms of controlled systems and optimal control formalizing boundary conditions and objective functions. osseointegration supposed to be controlled by methods of impulse control applying to engineering systems. As the result, authors compose system of ordinary differential equations associates state of system `bone - implant' (phase coordinates) with concentrations of certain signaling molecules in osseointegration zone (controlling actions) in general form. The obtained system of equations, after the substitution of numeric or intervallic values, could be used in dental implantology, traumatology and orthopedics. The proposed prototype model opens the way to develop new generation of implants, which combine controlling actions with different predefined properties.

articleTitle: Simulation of the Influence of Amount of Choline in Food on Dynamics of the Life Parameters of the Organism with Craniocerebral Injury
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: With a method of mathematical modeling the relationship of certain indicators reflecting the relationship of content quantity of choline in food, the expression level of α7 nicotinic acetylcholine receptors in the brain, as well as mass bodies of animals their intake of food and water has been studied. Based on the received model a method for optimizing the use of choline-excess diet to more fully maintain cognitive functions of the brain and other indicators of the State of the organism in brain injury has developed. The developed model allowed obtaining qualitatively new information useful to interpret the data and to deepen notions about the mechanisms of the relationship of the above processes received. The results can be used for correction of brain disorders by using choline in experimental animal models and in the clinic.

articleTitle: Fintech Ecosystem in Russia
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: Fintech is today not only a hot mass media discussion of the future of the financial sector, but also real projects that change banking and financial services. The paper describes features and characteristics of contemporary Russian fintech landscape and ecosystem. The examples of innovative financial services in Russia, including online banking and accounting, new payments and transfers services, platforms for crowdfunding and peer-to-peer lending, blockchain initiatives, etc. are discussed. It is shown that fintech initiatives have not yet led to a radical transformation of the financial sector in Russia because participants of the fintech ecosystem have different points of view on fintech. Russian banks are now developing fintech initiatives within themselves, encouraging technology companies and fintech startups to focus their efforts on innovations that are aimed at improving processes, rather than opening new markets. The Government directs the main efforts to initiatives related to regulation of cryptocurrencies circulation and to introduction of blockchain in regtech and cybersecurity. Customers are interested in new and more convenient functionality in mobile applications, and they are waiting for new value propositions, including fast international money transfers, roboadvising, personal financial management, peer-to-peer lending.

articleTitle: Towards Network Calculus A Review of Theories for Dealing With Facilities of Increased Danger
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: From antiquity to the present, queues and delays have seemed to be phenomena human beings are always encountering with. Such events are assumed to be probabilistic and described by stochastic models in classical science. In fact, queueing theory, a great branch of probability theory, handles these problems. At the same time, relatively new theory of deterministic queuing systems, or network calculus, considers queues and delays as being deterministic and operates with regular bounds. The article presents a historical review, basic ideas and results of conventional queueing theory and its competitor, network calculus, highlighting the advantages of the latter for dealing with facilities of increased danger.

articleTitle: Technical Opportunities to Improve the Intelligence of Modern Automatic Control System of Large Power Plants
publicationTitle: 2018 Eleventh International Conference "Management of large-scale system development" (MLSD
abstract: The report presents the current state and problems of modern ACS by software and hardware systems, including a low level of their efficiency. We show the insufficient level of use of information and functionality of modern software and hardware systems. The technical possibilities of increasing the intelligence of ACS TP of large power plants by expanding the functionality of the application software by solving optimization problems, block and station levels in an automatic mode according to the criterion of overall efficiency. We show the problems arising during the transition of the ACS TP to the group proactive process control at the level of the power plant.
